subject: Your M'Arte account has been deleted
preview: Confirmation that your account has been deleted, with what we deleted and what we keep.
heading: Until we meet again
message: As you requested, we have deleted the M'Arte account associated with this email address.
deleted: We deleted your profile (name, email address, phone number, password, two-factor settings and links to sign-in providers such as Google), your saved addresses, wishlist, newsletter subscription, sign-in history and the record of your activity in the shop, and your customer profile at our payment provider Stripe together with your saved cards.
kept: We keep your orders and payments, with the names, addresses, contact and invoice details on them, for 5 years from the end of the year of each order, because accounting and tax law requires it. They are no longer linked to an account. If you create a new account with this email address and confirm it, they will appear in it again.
messageSecondary: We are sorry to see you go — everyone who chooses M'Arte is special to us. Should you ever wish to return, our doors remain open.
messageTertiary: Our collection is still here for you. You may continue browsing the shop without an account, or create a new one whenever you are ready.
security: If you did not request account deletion, please reply to this email as soon as possible — we want to make sure everything is in order.
signoff: With gratitude for the time you spent with us,
